pages.text: Welcome to Refined Storage 2! This mod allows you to build a powerful storage network to manage all your items and fluids. In this guide, we'll walk through the core concepts and help you set up your first storage system.$(br2)Core Concept:$(br)Refined Storage 2 is built around a network of connected devices that work together to store and manage your resources. Everything starts with a Controller - the heart of your network.

Basic Requirements:$(br)$(li)Power (RF/FE/E energy)$(li)Controller$(li)Storage (Disk Drive or Storage Blocks)$(li)Access Interface (Grid)$(br2)Your network needs power to function. Any standard RF/FE/E power source will work. The Controller distributes this power to all connected devices. RS2 has improved energy efficiency and better power distribution.

Step 1: The Controller$(br)Start by crafting a Controller. This block:$(br)$(li)Powers your entire network$(li)Connects all devices together$(li)Must be powered with RF/FE/E$(li)Supports multiple controllers for larger networks$(br2)Place the Controller where you want your network's core to be. All devices must connect to it, either directly or through Cables.

Step 2: Storage Setup$(br)You'll need storage capacity for your network. Two main options:$(br)$(li)Disk Drive with Storage Disks$(li)Storage Blocks$(br2)For beginners, start with:$(br)1. Craft a Disk Drive$(br)2. Create a 1k Storage Disk$(br)3. Insert the disk into the drive$(br)Your network can now store up to 1,000 items! RS2 features improved storage management and better type handling.

Step 3: Accessing Your Storage$(br)To interact with your storage, you'll need a Grid:$(br)$(li)Basic Grid - View and manage items$(li)Crafting Grid - Includes a crafting table$(li)Pattern Grid - For autocrafting setup$(br2)RS2 introduces improved grid performance and better search functionality. Connect your Grid to the network (directly or with Cables) and start managing your items!

Next Steps:$(br)RS2 offers many advanced features:$(br)$(li)Enhanced autocrafting with the new Autocrafter$(li)Improved fluid handling and storage$(li)Better wireless connectivity$(li)New security features$(li)Integration with modern mods$(br2)Check the other sections of this manual for detailed information on these features. RS2 is designed to be more performant and user-friendly than ever!
